title: Numbers
lyrics:
[00:20.60]I don't know what to do, I don't know what to say
[00:25.83]My mind is killing me, these numbers aren't going straight up
[00:30.90]Maybe if I talk about some things I don't really wanna talk about
[00:35.32]I'll make some money, and I'll go on tour
[00:37.93]So I don't have to go to school anymore
[00:40.94]Things just really aren't that bad
[00:42.94]I got a nice mom, and I got a cool dad
[00:45.91]I just stay in my room too long
[00:48.06]But I finally got a girlfriend, and she's the bomb
[00:50.68](Hi!) (Hello)
[01:00.47](Hi, hi, hi)
